text:
Before: a latte in a tall mug (~300 ml, mostly milk, ~120 kcal), sautéed mushrooms (~80 g, ~70 kcal with oil), a baguette slice (~40 g, ~110 kcal), and a chocolate chip muffin (~100 g, ~400 kcal).

After: the mushrooms and bread are gone. The latte is mostly drunk, with a little foam or residue left. The muffin looks mostly uneaten, though its top seems slightly different. It may have lost a small bite or the chips were picked off. I'll assume about 10% of it was eaten.

Eaten:
- Latte: ~90% of 120 kcal ≈ 108 kcal, ~270 g
- Mushrooms: 70 kcal, 80 g
- Bread: 110 kcal, 40 g
- Muffin: ~10% ≈ 40 kcal, 10 g

Total ≈ 328 kcal and ~400 g. The mass is mostly the latte liquid. I'll round to 330 kcal and 400 g.
